name: cte
description: CTE form; the CTE name must not be treated as an unknown table.

execution.sql:
WITH spend AS (
  SELECT employee_id, currency_code, SUM(amount) AS total_spend
  FROM card_transactions
  WHERE transaction_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
  GROUP BY employee_id, currency_code
)
SELECT e.full_name, s.currency_code, s.total_spend
FROM spend AS s
JOIN employees AS e ON s.employee_id = e.employee_id
ORDER BY s.total_spend DESC
LIMIT 10
